description: I’m an engineering student passionate about space tech, hardware, and building clean, interactive web experiences. Join our team to create a fun, straightforward Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer—looking for creative teammates in UI/graphic design, basic coding, or storytelling to help bring the concept to life!
summary:
Mars Outpost Command is an interactive, browser-based survival simulation built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that puts players in charge of a Martian habitat for a 15-Sol mission. To keep the crew alive, players have to balance a limited 100 kW solar power grid across three vital systems: Oxygen Scrubbers, Hydroponic Grow Lights, and Magnetic Radiation Shielding.
This directly tackles the Junior Astronaut Mission challenge by turning real aerospace engineering trade-offs into hands-on gameplay. Instead of just reading about life in space, students get to experience the pressure of managing limited energy when sudden Martian hazards—like dust storms that cut solar power, radiation-spiking solar flares, and unexpected airlock leaks—force them to adapt their strategy on the fly.
details: Mars Outpost Command is a simple web game built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that runs directly in any web browser without needing special hardware or extra software. In the game, players act as the commander of a Mars base and must survive for 15 Martian days (Sols) by using sliders to share limited solar power between three vital systems: Oxygen, Food, and Radiation Shielding. Every time the player moves to the next day, the game updates the resource levels and adds random space emergencies like dust storms, solar flares, or airlock leaks. This project helps people learn problem-solving, planning, and how to handle emergencies in a fun and easy-to-access way, with the goal of inspiring students to get excited about science, engineering, and space travel. To make the project creative and enjoyable, we designed a dark space-themed control panel with colorful progress bars, and our team carefully balanced the game's math rules, added warning locks so players cannot use more power than they have, and made sure all resource scores stay neatly between 0% and 100% so the game works smoothly.
